name: Upper building pad 2 (about 316 m)
notes: Level 16 × 16 m pad at about 316 m needs roughly 62 m³ of cut and fill (up to 1.2 m deep). About 9.5 h of winter sun (terrain only), north-facing. Mid-slope: sheltered, with moderate cold-air risk. One of the two upper building sites Brett and Blake are working out access to (23 Oct). Computed pad site: check on site.
